Class SoftOffersService

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.SoftOffersService
@Service public class SoftOffersService extends Object
The applicant's side of soft offers (issue #486, part of #483): which of the signed-in user's applications has an open soft offer, what it says, and recording the answer.

An offer is open for an application when its recruitment is a ULA one whose soft offers are released (issue #485), the application is live (not cancelled, not hidden by an admin) and it has a tentative assignment to a lecture of that recruitment. The rules live here so the admin's results page (issue #487) agrees with what applicants see.

    • respond

      public SoftOfferResponse respond(String email, Long applicationId, SoftOfferDecision decision, String comments)
      Records the applicant's answer to their open soft offer.
      Throws:
      EntityNotFoundException - for an unknown application
      ForbiddenException - for someone else's application
      IllegalArgumentException - when no soft offer is open for it, or the comments are too long
      IllegalStateException - when this (application, lecture) offer has been answered already

      Throws:
